mapper.select: SELECT card_id AS cardId, user_id AS userId, card_num AS cardNum, expiry_date AS expiryDate, represent_yn AS representYn, 'SUCCESS' AS paymentStatus, '대표 카드가 조회되었습니다.' AS message FROM registered_card_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND represent_yn = 'Y' LIMIT 1
SELECT card_id AS cardId, user_id AS userId, card_num AS cardNum, expiry_date AS expiryDate, represent_yn AS representYn FROM registered_card_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY card_id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM registered_card_tbl WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND represent_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO registered_card_tbl ( user_id, account_id, card_num, expiry_date, cvv, card_password, represent_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{accountId}, #{cardNum}, #{expiryDate}, #{cvv}, #{cardPassword}, #{representYn} )

INSERT INTO linked_card_tbl ( user_id, card_id, card_company_code, card_name, card_image_name, represent_yn ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{cardId}, 'KB', COALESCE(#{cardName}, 'KB국민카드'), COALESCE(#{cardImageName}, '/images/cards/nori2.png'), #{representYn} )

INSERT INTO user_agreements_tbl ( user_id, agreement_id, agreed_yn, agreed_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{agreementId}, #{agreedYn}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE agreed_yn = #{agreedYn}, agreed_at = NOW()
